## Overview
The `AOK_KnowledgeBase_sugar` class is the auto-generated base class for the Knowledge Base module. It extends the Basic class and provides core SugarBean functionality for managing knowledge base articles with workflow features including author and approver relationships. This class should not be modified directly as it is regenerated by Module Builder.

## Class Structure

### Class Hierarchy
- **AOK_KnowledgeBase_sugar** (Auto-generated base class)
  - Extends **Basic** (Core SuiteCRM basic module class)

### Public Properties
#### Database Configuration
- `$new_schema = true` - Uses new database schema format
- `$module_dir = 'AOK_KnowledgeBase'` - Module directory name

## Module Builder Notes
